checkpoint_policy: Use the exact checkpoint selected by S1 for calibration and validation. Do not retune the policy on Official-100 or external PPA outcomes.
selection_rule: Both manifests exclude every previously opened refiner index and each contains one deterministic case from every approximately eight-block-wide stratum.
calibration_protocol: Collect observable snapshots on calibration8 before reading validation outcomes.
Fit a predeclared threshold or monotone rule using calibration labels only through scripts/calibrate_chip_adaptive_refiner.py.
Serialize the selected rule, thresholds and all considered candidates before opening validation8.
Evaluate the frozen rule once on validation8 and charge the selected refiner step count.
Reject post-hoc case-specific thresholds and oracle snapshot selection.

deployable_search.total_compute: Report generation, refiner, scorer, legalization and EDA response separately.
deployable_search.selector: Only a shared label-free scorer fitted without validation or target leakage may select candidates.

promotion_gate.comparison: Beat or match fixed refiner1600 after total compute accounting.
reject_if: The apparent gain depends on target labels, case identity or oracle snapshot selection.
Best-of-N cost omits failed draws or scorer calls.
promotion_gate.development_result: On the 32-case dev snapshot curve, fixed 3200 improves aggregate cost 0.10% and V_rel 6.43% over 1600, but 11/32 cases have non-improving cost and no label-free rank rule clears the quality guard while saving compute. This is not a promotion result.
